subject: Proposal: Net60 + Optional Early-Remit Sweep; VAT Routing Details
messages:
From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@brightlane.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood commercial ask - net terms and VAT treatment

Hi Nikhil,

Following our procurement review this morning, BrightLane would like to see if Redwood can accommodate Net60 terms for our annual contract while also offering an option for an "early-remit sweep" (we remit within 10 days for a 1.25% reduction). We operate across US and a small EU test cluster - VAT handling is something our tax team flagged.

Can you confirm: 1) whether Net60 with an early-remit discount is acceptable; 2) how Redwood will invoice across our US parent vs EU entity (they need VAT-inclusive invoices); and 3) an estimate for credit limit/guardrail given expected monthly spend (we expect $120k/mo during Q1 pilot).

Copying Evelyn so we can align on account management. Can you send a short payment schedule and any standard docs we should attach to our PO?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Bennett
AP Manager, BrightLane Health
attachments: BrightLane-PO-conditional.pdf (pdf)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@brightlane.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood commercial ask - net terms and VAT treatment

Hi Sarah - thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary of what we can offer and open items:

Proposed commercial terms (draft):
- Payment term: Net60 for the contract.
- Early-remit option: 1.25% invoice-level discount if payment clears within 10 calendar days of invoice date. Applies to Redwood hosted charges only (excludes pass-through cloud taxes/fees).
- Credit guardrail: provisional $250k credit line to start (about 2x expected monthly). We will monitor usage and billing telemetry during a 60-day ramp before any step-up.
- VAT/invoicing: Redwood can issue VAT-inclusive invoices to your EU entity if you provide EU VAT registration and remit entity details; otherwise we will invoice US parent and include reverse-charge language for the EU cluster.

Attached is a sample payment schedule and a revised SOW (REDWOOD-SOW-v2.pdf). Open items we need from BrightLane:
1) EU VAT registration number and legal invoicing entity for EU charges.
2) Confirmation whether early-remit should be per-invoice (recommended) or aggregated monthly.
3) Bank details & authorization form if you opt-in to automated sweep (ACH for US, SEPA for EU).

If this is acceptable, Connor will prepare a DocuSign packet and Naomi will initiate a quick credit application.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai
attachments: REDWOOD-SOW-v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-11T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood commercial ask - net terms and VAT treatment

Notes from finance: 
- The provisional $250k credit line is acceptable for the pilot at $120k/mo; final approval pending credit application and trade refs.
- Early-remit discount: finance requires per-invoice application and explicit clause that the discount only applies to undisputed invoices that clear within 10 days (we need bank trace).
- VAT routing: if BrightLane supplies an EU VAT ID and legal entity, we will generate VAT-inclusive invoices from our EU billing entity. If not provided, we will include standard reverse-charge wording.

Suggested sample billing cadence to include in the SOW: 
- Invoice cadence: monthly, invoice created on day 1 for prior month usage.
- Payment due: day 60 from invoice date.
- Early remit: 1.25% if payment posts by day 10.
- Sweep option: automated early sweep via ACH/SEPA if AP provides authorization; finance to validate bank trace for discount application.

I will prepare the credit memo and a short checklist for their AP to attach to the PO. Connor - please confirm DocuSign flow and include credit application link.

- Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Redwood commercial ask - net terms and VAT treatment

DocuSign plan: 
- Two-step sign flow: Commercial sign-off (Evelyn) then Finance sign-off (Naomi).
- Envelope contents: SOW/price exhibit, payment schedule, early-remit addendum, credit application link.
- The early-remit discount will be an optional checkbox in the envelope and requires AP to consent to automated sweep if selected.

I'll assemble the packet and hold sending until Naomi confirms credit threshold.

Connor O'Brien
Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Bennett <sarah.bennett@brightlane.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@brightlane.com, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-13T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood commercial ask - net terms and VAT treatment

Thanks Nikhil/Naomi/Connor 999for the quick turnaround. BrightLane can provide the EU VAT ID and confirm EU legal entity for VAT-inclusive invoices. We prefer the per-invoice early-remit discount and will supply ACH/SEPA bank details once the DocuSign packet is live.

Please send the DocuSign link when ready and we will route the PO from procurement.

Regards,
Sarah
AP Manager, BrightLane Health
attachments: BrightLane-PO-conditional.pdf (pdf)
